acceptance: Deletion lists generated, archived, and executed; archive tags created for auto-revert/* and any branch with unmerged commits
No workflow references a deleted label or secret (G4)
description:
Pre-approved admin changes (standing approvals); G5 backups and archive tags first.
Branches: gh-readonly-queue/* with no queued entry and no workflow run referencing the SHA; auto-revert/* after closing their PRs (archive tags first); auto/* whose PRs are closed; fix/*, claude/*, feat/*, docs/*, chore/* whose PRs are merged or closed. Never delete develop, published-results, todo-state, v*, or any branch with an open PR. (`release` is removed in dlv2-53, `publication` in dlv2-62.)
Labels: delete incident:develop-red, incident:develop-red-revert-conflict, incident:release-canary-red, no-auto-merge; keep awaiting-owner and incident:todo-export-failed; confirm quarantine and t3:* labels exist.
Secrets: delete TODO_DB_URL, TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN, TODO_EXPORT_PR_TOKEN if rg finds no reference anywhere in the repo (workflows, scripts, docs); otherwise keep and record why. Keep CODECOV_TOKEN (D6) and RULESET_DRIFT_TOKEN (D7).
